text: Summon a Maledictor (14 HP, 3 Power). Attacks apply 2 Scorch. With 3 Maledictors, open a Hellgate at turn end: 6 damage and 2 Scorch to all enemies; promote all soldiers. Once per turn. Persists until destroyed.
